pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #45354

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [ ] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
```
func BenchmarkPointGet(b *testing.B) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	se, do, st := prepareBenchSession()
	defer func() {
		se.Close()
		do.Close()
		st.Close()
	}()
	mustExecute(se, "create table t (pk int primary key) partition by hash(pk) partitions 4")
	mustExecute(se, "insert t values (61),(62),(63),(64),(-1),(-2)")
	mustExecute(se, "analyze table t")
	b.ResetTimer()
	alloc := chunk.NewAllocator()
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		rs, err := se.Execute(ctx, "select * from t where pk = -1")
		if err != nil {
			b.Fatal(err)
		}
		_, err = drainRecordSet(ctx, se.(*session), rs[0], alloc)
		if err != nil {
			b.Fatal(err)
		}

		alloc.Reset()
	}
	b.StopTimer()
}

before (TableScan)
BenchmarkPointGet-8   	    8542	    123092 ns/op	   65296 B/op	     966 allocs/op

after (PointGet)
BenchmarkPointGet-8   	   18720	     64514 ns/op	   46968 B/op	     681 allocs/op
```
- [ ] No code

Side effects

- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU
- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory
- [ ] Breaking backward compatibility

Documentation

- [ ] Affects user behaviors
- [ ] Contains syntax changes
- [ ] Contains variable changes
- [ ] Contains experimental features
- [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility

issue_context.title: cannot generate PointGet plan for partition table with date partition key
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

cannot generate PointGet plan for partition table with date partition key, but partition table with int partition key can generate PointGet plan.

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

```
CREATE TABLE ccccc (
    id INT NOT NULL,
    fname VARCHAR(30),
    lname VARCHAR(30),
    hired DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01',
    separated DATE DEFAULT '9999-12-31',
    job_code INT,
    store_id INT NOT NULL,
    primary key (id,separated) 
)
PARTITION BY list (day(separated)) (
    PARTITION p0 VALUES in (1),
    PARTITION p1 VALUES in (2),
    PARTITION p2 VALUES  in (3)
);

insert into ccccc values(1,'a','a','1970-01-01','1970-01-01',1,1);

explain update ccccc set lname='test1' where id=1 and separated='1970-01-01' limit 1;


analyze table ccccc;

explain update ccccc set lname='test1' where id=1 and separated='1970-01-01' limit 1;  # except Point_Get_12 plan but get IndexRangeScan_11




CREATE TABLE ddddd (
    id INT NOT NULL,
    fname VARCHAR(30),
    lname VARCHAR(30),
    hired DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01',
    separated DATE DEFAULT '9999-12-31',
    job_code INT,
    store_id INT NOT NULL,
    primary key (id,store_id) 
)
PARTITION BY list (store_id) (
    PARTITION p0 VALUES in (1),
    PARTITION p1 VALUES in (2),
    PARTITION p2 VALUES  in (3)
);


insert into ddddd values(1,'a','a','1970-01-01','1970-01-01',1,1);
insert into ddddd values(2,'b','b','1970-01-02','1970-01-02',2,2);

explain update ddddd set lname='test1' where id=1 and store_id=1 limit 1; 

analyze table ddddd;


explain update ddddd set lname='test1' where id=1 and store_id=1 limit 1; 

```
### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

all update statement has pointget plan.
